question.problem: The time, in hours, it takes to empty a pool varies inversely with the rate of pumping, in gallons per hour ($\text{gph}$). If it takes $5$ hours to empty the pool at a rate of $200\,\text{gph},$ what is the constant of variation?
question.worked_solution:
The time $t$ is inversely proportional to the rate of pumping $r,$ so we have

$$
t=\frac{k}{r},
$$

where $k$ is the constant of variation.

We are told that it takes $5$ hours to empty the pool at a rate of $200\,\text{gph}.$  We can use this information to solve for $k$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5 & =\frac{k}{200} \\ 5\cdot 200 & =k \\ 1\,000 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our final answer is $k=1\,000.$
